description: Colombo Municipal Council - Narahenpita, Thibirigasyaya D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition for a road widening and development project. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired, including lot numbers, assessment numbers, property descriptions, claimants, and extents. The notice is issued under the Land Acquisition Act and falls squarely within the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
